founder.name: Majid
founder.title: Co-founder & CEO
founder.bio: Majid has always been passionate about sustainability and design. With a vision to reduce single-use plastic, Majid co-founded AquaBrand to provide a stylish and eco-friendly alternative for hydration. His mission is to empower businesses and individuals to make a positive impact on the environment, one custom bottle at a time.

founder.name: Arbaaz
founder.title: Co-founder & COO
founder.bio: Arbaaz brings operational excellence and a customer-centric approach to AquaBrand. He ensures that every bottle meets the highest standards of quality and that the company's growth is sustainable. Arbaaz is dedicated to building a brand that customers love and trust.
